scientific_integrity: An unrestricted proof is given. Direct small-order exhaustion and constructive checks are supplementary; neither constitutes external mathematical certification. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple complete multipartite graphs with at least two nonempty parts and minimum degree at least two; static strong-majority vertex colouring only. No assertion for degree-one graphs or arbitrary graphs. The two-colour even-part result and the complete-graph \(K_4\) exception are credited to earlier literature; only the remaining three-versus-four classification and pair-augmentation construction are presented as new. Bibliographic priority is subject to unindexed or equivalently phrased work.
title: Strong-majority vertex-colouring numbers of complete multipartite graphs
